title: Yadda ɗakin tausa ya ƙara samun kwastomomi daga taswira
excerpt: Ɗakin tausa ya inganta bayanan kasuwancinsa, ra’ayoyi da sabuntawa na yau da kullum domin samun ƙarin tambayoyi daga taswira.
seoTitle: Ƙarin kwastomomi ga ɗakin tausa — nazarin LocalOS
seoDescription: Nazarin yadda ɗakin tausa ya inganta bayanan taswira, ra’ayoyi da abun ciki domin samun ƙarin kwastomomi.
situation: Ɗakin yana da kyakkyawan ƙima, amma bayanin kasuwancin ya yi gama-gari: ayyuka ba su bayyana sosai ba, hotunan sakamako ba su isa ba, kuma babu sabuntawa akai-akai.
actions: mun raba ayyuka bisa bukatun kwastomomi
mun ƙara bayani da farashi masu sauƙin fahimta
mun shirya amsoshi ga sabbin ra’ayoyi
mun tsara wallafe-wallafe na ayyuka da tayin musamman
result: Bayanin kasuwancin ya fara dacewa da takamaiman bincike, kuma mai kasuwanci ya samu tsarin sabuntawa mai sauƙi ba tare da aikin hannu kullum ba.

body.title: Abin da ya fi aiki
body.body: Bayyanannun bayanan ayyuka, sabbin ra’ayoyi da hotuna masu dacewa ne suka kawo babban canji. Kwastomomi sun fi saurin fahimtar abin da za su zaɓa da abin da ya bambanta ɗakin.

title: Yadda salon kwalliya ya samu sabbin alƙawura 10 a rana daga taswira
excerpt: Salon kwalliya ya fayyace ayyukansa, ya tsara amsa ra’ayoyi, sannan ya gina tsari mai amfani ga bayanan kasuwancinsa.
seoTitle: Yadda salon ya samu sabbin alƙawura daga taswira — LocalOS
seoDescription: Nazarin yadda bayanai, ayyuka, ra’ayoyi da hotuna masu kyau suka taimaka wa salon samun ƙarin alƙawura daga taswira.
situation: Salon ya dogara da kwastomomin da ke dawowa, yayin da sababbi daga taswira suke zuwa ba bisa tsari ba. Ayyuka suna nan, amma zaɓinsu bai kasance mai sauƙi ba.
actions: mun sake rubuta bayanin kasuwanci domin dacewa da bincike
result: Bayanan sun fi sauƙin fahimta ga sabon kwastoma: ana ganin ayyuka, farashi, dalilan amincewa da dalilin zaɓar salon.

body.title: Abin da muka koya
body.body: Kyawun bayanin salon kaɗai bai isa ba; zaɓi dole ya zama mai sauƙi. Kwastoma ya kamata ya gane aikin da ya dace da mataki na gaba cikin sauri.

title: Yadda ƙaramin gidan kofi ya ƙara yawan baƙi a ranakun aiki
excerpt: Gidan kofi kusa da ofisoshi ya tsara bayanansa bisa karin kumallo, abincin rana da kofi na tafiya, don sauƙaƙa zaɓin masu kusa.
seoTitle: Nazarin gidan kofi: ƙarin baƙi a ranakun aiki — LocalOS
seoDescription: Nazarin yadda sabunta bayanai, jerin abinci, hotuna da ra’ayoyi ya taimaka wajen ƙara baƙi a ranakun aiki.
situation: Gidan kofi yana bayyana idan an nemi sunansa, amma ba kasafai yake fitowa ga bukatun kusa kamar karin kumallo, abincin rana na aiki ko kofi na tafiya ba.
actions: mun raba bayanan bisa dalilan ziyara
mun ƙara hotunan abinci tare da sabunta bayanin shahararrun kayayyaki
mun ƙirƙiri samfurin amsa ra’ayoyin baƙi
result: Bayanan sun fi bayyana ga ma’aikatan ofisoshi na kusa. Mutane sun fi neman kwatance, yin kira da rubuta ra’ayi bayan ziyara.

body.title: Me ya sa ya yi aiki
body.body: Gidan kofi ya daina zama ɗigo kawai a taswira. Bayanan sun nuna dalilan shigowa: karin kumallo kafin aiki, abincin rana kusa da ofis, da kofi na tafiya.

body.title: Abin da za a iya maimaitawa
items: riƙe jerin abinci da hotuna a matsayin sabuwar taga ta kasuwanci
duba ra’ayoyi da tambayoyi sau ɗaya a mako
bayyana lokutan da kwastoma zai zaɓi gidan kofi na kusa
